paper_title: Personalized risk stratification in colorectal cancer via PIANOS system
prediction_task: CRC 3-year recurrence prediction from transcriptomic risk score

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Outcome used in benchmarking is 3-year recurrence, but several benchmark methods were developed for 5-year OS/RFS. Should tabulate timepoint and outcome metric for each benchmark method — risk of comparing apples and pears.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Added table comparing timepoints and outcome metrics across all benchmarked methods.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Can performance be benchmarked to mIHC scores such as ImmunoScore and SIA? Should include iCMS system and CRPS system (Nunes 2024) for comparison.
Associations between OS and bevacizumab use are questionable. Only 30 patients with mixed treatment histories — too small to make conclusions about response prediction to bevacizumab.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Toned down bevacizumab response claims and noted as exploratory analysis.

reviewer_strengths.text: The developed predictor performs well when benchmarked to other transcriptomic predictors.
